_comment: Per-identity remediation allowlist for hermes-remediate-worker.py. An identity may only request a restart or nudge target listed here for her -- anything else is refused and logged, not silently ignored. Add new approved actions by adding entries here; no code change needed. Gateway services are deliberately excluded (direct decision, 2026-08-21: restarting one's own gateway kills the current turn -- too risky for an unattended v1).
